hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.new_file_path // ""' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -q '\.rs$' && [ -f "Cargo.toml" ] && cargo fmt 2>/dev/null || true; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.new_file_path // ""' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|css)$' && [ -f "$f" ] && npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; }
